name: NGC 3583 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3583, a barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: n3583-hubble
story: Two arms twist outward from the central bar of this spiral galaxy. Two stars have exploded here as supernovae, one in 1975 and another in 2015, each a white dwarf pushed past its limit by a companion.

claims.text: NGC 3583 is a barred spiral galaxy with two arms
Two supernovae, in 1975 and 2015, from white dwarfs in binary systems
Observed in program 15145 (Hubble constant from Cepheids in hosts of Type Ia supernovae)
